title: Conditional κ = 0.001654192296855146: joint three- and four-call owners on PR656
body:
This improves pinned #656 from **κ = 0.001654108529511355** to **κ = 0.001654192296855146**, a **0.0050642%** gain, by reassigning whole-helper owners across three and four calls together. The conservative witness is **0.001654192293959223**.

The contribution is `research/layered-joint-owners/`: a standalone delta against #656, with frozen owners, reproducible search, solver-free owner audits, exact arithmetic, proof, source pins, and archived replay evidence. No existing repository files change. All **27 inherited Python files** and every construction input remain byte-identical when staged; only the parent PLAN owner/profile bookkeeping, OWNERS, and frozen SPEC change.

### What changes

- Generalizes jaymosley07's #653 two-call integer nomination model to several calls. From #656, 180 three-call groups accepted eight strict improvements; 120 four-call groups accepted four more. A bounded five-call follow-up accepted none; no neighborhood or global optimality is claimed.
- The final idle distribution is `{1:1, 3:1, 28:1, 32:2, 48:2398}`. Its integer stop-loss certificate strictly majorizes #656 at the same total rank. Both solver-free auditors check all 35,424 roles, literal footprints and profile accounting; the independent auditor re-derives controller windows and actual 73-column charts from fresh baseline evidence.
- Adds a **fixed-provider relaxed packing ceiling**: with these exact local costs and capacities, every owner map has κ below `0.001654249113130438` (exact fraction and certified root bracket supplied). This follows by relaxing to 2,400 dimension-48 idle remainders. Feasibility of that ideal packing is not asserted. The ceiling does not constrain different circuits or integer multiplication generally.

### Validation

On Linux, CPython 3.12.3, low CPU/I/O priority:

- Complete default replay from fresh outputs, no reused local/global artifacts: **PASS**, 199.427 seconds across 11 driver stages.
- Rebuilt the retained scalar word and all layers; 30 pivot-swap and 59 layer-end mutations rejected; native ledgers, wrappers, exact phases and independent scalar audit passed.
- Strict baseline #656 replay and independent owner audit passed; nine additional owner mutations rejected.
- New global controller, finite invoice, two exact moment engines and outer assembly passed, including 15 controller, 69 admission and 12 bit-supplier controls.
- Independent profile price and exact relaxed-ceiling check passed; final packaged incremental replay also passed.
- `git diff --check` passed. Earlier `make verify` on the identical unchanged main base `17ce0c79` passed all 18 groups, including `gen4-bank-verify`, and 84 isolated test modules. That earlier run is explicitly distinguished from this addition's fresh replay; its receipt/log are retained.

`README.md` has immutable fetch pins and the single replay command. `VALIDATION.json` and `evidence/` contain source identities, 24 selected artifacts and all 43 fresh replay logs. Verification needs only the Python standard library; NumPy/SciPy are optional discovery dependencies. Historical #645 evidence retained inside #656 is not treated as current owner/local evidence.

### Scope and credit

This is a **conditional finite witness** under the retained compiler, common-label/mutable-source, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, exact-recovery, analytic-transfer and bit H1–H5 interfaces. #589's bit circuit is cited unchanged and its full profile/surcharge freshly priced; it is not rebuilt here. No unconditional multiplication theorem or complete Lean proof is claimed.

Prepared by Jeremy Diviney with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credits retained: **Jay Mosley / jaymosley07 (#653)** for the two-call model, auditors and staging pattern; **jeremykothe2 (#655/#656, Claude Code)** for the layered provider and seed map; **icekylinx (#645, GPT-6 Astra/Codex)** for Gauge44; the #601/#604/#617/#627/#635/#637 end-construction lineage including DreamingOfClouds, jeremydiviney and CarrierBypass; **vectorsss / Chi Zhao (#638)** for earlier packing work; and **DreamingOfClouds (#589)** with its eumemic/Claude lineage for the bit supplier.
